messages:
rene: quick note — after yesterday's quota rollback i noticed odd behaviour on the latency pane for /v1/embeds (mobile). p50 dipped ~20ms, p95 same, p99 jumped ~280ms. mobile-only slice. anyone seen this?
hafsa: digging now. looks like the mobile callers got moved to a different route pool at ~09:12 UTC. routing-change id=rc-2026-04-12.
greg: timeline matches. i pulled raw samples and the distribution is bi-modal. small fraction have ~600ms transport spikes. rest around 40-80ms.
rene: are those spikes in service_time or transport_time?
hafsa: transport_time. traces show an extra NAT hop when routed to pool-b. sample of trace header:```
trace: ingress->proxy-b->pool-b-worker->gpu
transport_ms: 520
service_ms: 35
```
anya: observability-bot also fired a low-sample p99 alert for that slice earlier: "p99 > 200ms (sample_count=9)" — might be noisy.
observability-bot: Alert(LOW_SAMPLE_P99): channel=#eng-platform slice="mobile-eu" p99=512ms sample_count=9 rule_id=low-sample-p99-v1
greg: this is twofold: (1) routing policy change routed a tiny subset through a path with extra NAT/proxy causing transport spikes; (2) our alerting ignored sample_count and treats p99 same regardless of N.
rene: i don't want product owners to panic over a noisy p99 when sample_count<20. proposal: make p99 alerts sample-aware. threshold scale or require min_samples=50 to trigger SLO paging.
anya: also UX: console should clearly show "origin breakdown" (ingress / proxy / backend) with per-origin percentiles toggles. toggle off "proxy" and you'd see backend-only p99.
hafsa: backend-only p99 in raw logs is 78ms. so the issue is transport-only. good to highlight.
greg: small implementation notes: our rollup currently mixes samples with origin tag but legend aggregates them. two quick fixes: (A) show sample_count and top-origin inline tooltip; (B) add "confidence" badge when sample_count<50 with hover explaining variance.
rene: +1. add a short sentence in rollout UI when route weights for fallback/proxy increase >3%: "expect transport latency variance" linking to per-origin view.
anya: i'll draft the UI copy. sth like: "Routing weight change detected — a small fraction of traffic now traverses proxy nodes which can add network latency. View per-origin breakdown."
greg: for alerting, i can add a pre-check: if sample_count < min_samples then lower severity to info and send to #eng-platform instead of paging. also add a one-off historical flag in alert body showing sample_count trend.
hafsa: opened infra issue: https://go/repo/issue/778 to track root cause and routing rollback.
rene: thanks. can we also add a quick CLI check to reproduce? sample command:```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -w "%{time_connect}\t%{time_starttransfer}\n" -o /dev/null "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds?prefix=mobile-eu"; done | sort -n | tail -n 20
```
anya: nice. i'll pin that to the issue.
greg: final ask — telemetry team: please expose per-origin percentile in the API (query param origin=ingress|proxy|backend) so infra scripts can programmatically verify.
observability-bot: noted. created telemetry task T-90123.
rene: thanks all. i'll mute the paging rule for this slice for 24h while we roll the UI/tooling. will update the issue with reproduction results later.
